The '''Cheruba system''' was located in the [[Rifle Worlds]], an area of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was connected to the [[Charubah system/Legends|Charubah]] and [[Relephon system/Legends|Relephon systems]] via the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Gallinore Reach]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Cheruba [[Star system/Legends|system]] shared its name with the competitions known as the [[Cheruban glach race]]s.<ref name="Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Cheruba system was introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it within grid square O-9.<ref name="TEA" />
